# DroidHand tools

<!-- Generated by mcp-server/scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts (npm run docs:tools). Do not edit by hand. -->

39 MCP tools in 9 areas. Tools are forwarded to the phone unless marked **local (host)**, in which case the relay daemon handles them itself.

Notes column: the risk **tier** recorded in the audit log; **confirm on device** means the app asks the user to approve the action on the phone first.

## Shared arguments

- `display`: display id (0 = phone screen; bg_open id = background). On 0, if the user is using the phone the app may ask them first: errors 'awaiting_user' (retry shortly) or 'user_declined' (use bg_open instead).
- `ref`: stable element ref from screen_snapshot, e.g. '@4'.

Every tool that is not local also accepts `display`; it is left out of the tables below.

## Perception

Read what is on screen and on the device.

| Tool | What it does | Inputs | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `screen_snapshot` | Accessibility tree of the foreground app with stable @refs, roles, text and bounds. | `detail` "compact" \| "full" (optional) | standard |
| `screen_capture` | PNG screenshot of the current screen (base64). | `quality` number 1–100 (optional) | standard |
| `get_foreground_app` | Package and activity currently in the foreground. | — | standard |
| `list_windows` | Windows on screen as the accessibility service sees them (type, layer, active/focused, package). | — | standard |
| `get_notifications` | List active notifications with refs and actions. | `package` string (optional) | standard |
| `list_apps` | Installed launchable apps (personal profile). | `includeSystem` boolean (optional) | standard |

| Tool | What it does | Inputs | Notes |

| `tap` | Tap an element by ref, or raw x,y. | `ref` string (optional)<br>`x` number (optional)<br>`y` number (optional) | standard |

| `global_action` | Perform a global accessibility action. | `action` "notifications" \| "quick_settings" \| "clear_all_notifications" \| "screenshot" \| "lock_screen" | standard |

## Lock screen

Lock state and opt-in PIN unlock (the PIN never leaves the phone).

| Tool | What it does | Inputs | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_lock_state` | Screen on/off, locked, secure lock, and whether PIN unlock by the agent is enabled. | — | standard |
| `unlock_device` | Unlock the phone with the PIN the user saved in the DroidHand app (opt-in, off by default; the PIN never leaves the phone). Wakes the screen, opens the PIN pad and enters it. One wrong attempt disables the feature. Only when the task needs the main screen. | — | privileged |

## ADB on demand

Short-lived, user-confirmed ADB sessions for privileged work.

| Tool | What it does | Inputs | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adb_session_begin` | Enable wireless debugging and open a short-lived local ADB session. Auto-closes on TTL. | `reason` string<br>`ttlSeconds` number 10–1800 (optional) | privileged · confirm on device |
| `adb_shell` | Run a shell command inside an open ADB session. | `command` string | privileged · confirm on device |
| `adb_install` | Install an APK already present on the phone. | `apkPath` string | privileged · confirm on device |
| `pm_grant` | Grant a runtime permission to a package. | `package` string<br>`permission` string | privileged · confirm on device |
| `adb_session_end` | Close the ADB session and disable wireless debugging. | — | privileged |

## Background display

Work on a separate display while the user keeps using the phone.

| Tool | What it does | Inputs | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg_open` | Open a background display and return its displayId; then pass display=&lt;id&gt; to launch_app, screen_snapshot, screen_capture, tap, swipe, scroll, type_text, key_event. mode: 'native' (system window, works with debugging OFF, cannot be hidden), 'own' (our window: hideable, resizable, user can interact; needs own_helper_start and debugging ON), 'auto' (own if the helper runs, else native). The user's choice in the app overrides mode (see forcedByUser). Safety: work in the background only happens while the user can see it (stop button + window, eye bubble or handle). If those cannot be shown, the session is closed and calls fail with 'indicators_not_visible' — do not retry in a loop. | `mode` "auto" \| "native" \| "own" (optional)<br>`width` number (optional)<br>`height` number (optional)<br>`dpi` number (optional) | standard |
| `bg_status` | Background display state: mode, displayId, hidden, helpPending, user's method choice, own helper availability. | — | standard |
| `bg_hide` | Hide the own-window background display (the agent keeps working; the user sees an eye bubble). | — | standard |
| `bg_show` | Show the background window again. | — | standard |
| `bg_close` | Close the background display (own: its apps are closed; native: they move behind the user's apps). | — | standard |
| `request_user_help` | Ask the user to take over in the background window (e.g. captcha, login). Shows the window with the message; poll bg_status until helpPending is null (the user taps the message when done). | `message` string | standard |
| `own_helper_start` | Start the shell helper over ADB from the NUC (needs USB/wireless debugging ON and the NUC paired). Enables the 'own' background-window method. The helper dies when debugging is turned off. | — | privileged · local (host) |
| `own_helper_stop` | Stop the shell helper (closes own-window background displays). | — | standard · local (host) |
